# Original OM-5 patched startup, tadejs ladder C5

The owner reports the ladder's last package, a half-press hook with a card read, starts and runs normally.

**Camera:** [OM SYSTEM OM-5](../cameras/om5.md) · **Project:** [Caduceus port for the original OM-5 (tadejs)](../projects/caduceus-om5-tadejs.md)

**Firmware:** [om5 firmware 1.2, build 1200](../firmware/om5-1200.md) · **Mod build:** om5-ladder-c5

The owner reports that the C5 package, the last of five ladder steps, starts and leaves shooting, playback, menus and video normal. Earlier steps C1–C4 are separate evidence records.

**Availability:** experimental branch. **Implementation basis:** reported.
